# Synthetic INF-08 fixture: Kubernetes workloads with unbounded containers.
apiVersion: apps/v1
kind: Deployment
metadata:
  name: web
  namespace: shop
spec:
  replicas: 3
  template:
    spec:
      containers:
        - name: app
          image: example/web:1.0
          ports:
            - containerPort: 8080
        - name: sidecar
          image: example/proxy:1.0
          resources:
            requests:
              cpu: 100m
              memory: 64Mi
---
apiVersion: v1
kind: Service
metadata:
  name: web
spec:
  ports:
    - port: 80
---
apiVersion: batch/v1
kind: CronJob
metadata:
  name: report
spec:
  schedule: "0 * * * *"
  jobTemplate:
    spec:
      template:
        spec:
          containers:
          - name: report
            image: example/report:1.0
            resources: {}
          restartPolicy: OnFailure
---
apiVersion: v1
kind: List
items:
  - apiVersion: v1
    kind: Pod
    metadata:
      name: worker
    spec:
      containers:
        - image: example/worker:1.0
          name: worker
          resources:
            limits: {memory: 256Mi}
